DRY_SMOKE.model_note: The DRY smoke's realized 4-arm mean is 1.430 s/continuation-decision at W=14 (nice -19, rust_threads 1) against an uncontended 1.345 s at W=1 — a contention factor of only ~1.06 at W=14. E-1b's realized LOCAL W=30 figure is 2.219 s, i.e. ~1.65x uncontended. PREREG §5 adopts E-1b's 2.219 as the model of record because this round runs at W=32 and no measurement of THIS round at W=32 exists yet; the figure is therefore CONSERVATIVE, and the uncontended 1.345 s floor is quoted beside every ETA so the range is visible. The launcher re-measures and refuses above ETA_CAP_H.
